topics.title: Hlaalu Company Scrip
evidence_facts: Hlaalu Company scrip consists of clay tokens issued as wages in place of Imperial gold septims.
Each token has the stated value of one septim but can be spent only at Hlaalu-owned establishments.
Workers fear that saved scrip becomes worthless when a mine and its company store close.

topics.title: Mole Crab
evidence_facts: Mole crabs have durable, lightweight shells used in the traditional light armor of Telvanni guards.
Their shells and other chitinous parts have distinct uses in armor making and bonemold production.
Their meat can substitute for mudcrab meat in alchemy, while unfertilized eggs are gathered for cooking and alchemical use.
